title: Death Star
description: THE DEATH STAR, destroyed once by Luke Skywalker, is being rebuilt as a larger, even deadlier armor space station as RETURN THE JEDI opens (front sketch by Joe Johnston). The actual model is a six-foot tall half-hemisphere that contains lots of lacy, laser-cut pieces to make the battle station look like it's under construction. For the final confrontation, when the Rebels try to blast the station's reactor core, the special effects crew built 360 feet of tunnels.
